Will you report all required changes during your certification period?
requirements.helpText: You are required to report certain changes in your circumstances that may affect your eligibility or benefit amount. The specific changes you must report depend on your reporting system assignment.

requirements.label: Do you understand you must report changes in gross monthly income that exceed 130% of the poverty level for your household size?
requirements.helpText: If you are assigned to simplified reporting, you must report income increases above this threshold. If assigned to change reporting, you must report all income changes over $100 within 10 days.

requirements.label: Do you understand you must report changes in household composition (people moving in or out) within 10 days?
requirements.helpText: This includes anyone who joins or leaves your household, as it affects your eligibility and benefit calculation.

requirements.label: Do you understand you must report changes in address and shelter costs within 10 days?
requirements.helpText: Moving to a new address or changes in rent, mortgage, or utility costs must be reported as they affect your benefit calculation.
